title: City Attorney report and draft ordinance relative to private ambulance service rate increases in the City of Los Angeles.
text:
[Council File 25-0583]
City Attorney report and draft ordinance relative to private ambulance service rate increases in the City of Los Angeles.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
No
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: City Attorney presented a draft ordinance to allow private ambulance service rate increases in Los Angeles.

outcome.text: Transportation Committee noted and filed the City Attorney report dated 7/24/26 and adopted the draft Ordinance (Aug 12, 2026); Council adopted item, subject to reconsideration, pursuant to Council Rule 51 (Aug 18, 2026); Council action final
